queries.title: Data validation
Date-level analysis
queries.sql:
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(`Date`, '%d-%m-%Y') AS record_date,
       COUNT(*) AS records,
       ROUND(AVG(`Price`), 2) AS average_price
FROM cleaned_inventory
GROUP BY STR_TO_DATE(`Date`, '%d-%m-%Y')
ORDER BY record_date;

queries.title: Category pricing
queries.sql:
SELECT `Category`,
       ROUND(AVG(`Price`), 2) AS average_price
FROM cleaned_inventory
GROUP BY `Category`
ORDER BY average_price DESC, `Category`;

queries.title: Inventory analysis
queries.sql:
SELECT `Category`,
       SUM(`Inventory Level`) AS inventory_observations
FROM cleaned_inventory
GROUP BY `Category`
ORDER BY inventory_observations DESC, `Category`;

queries.title: Sales analysis
queries.sql:
SELECT `Category`,
       SUM(`Units Sold`) AS total_units_sold
FROM cleaned_inventory
GROUP BY `Category`
ORDER BY total_units_sold DESC, `Category`;

queries.title: Demand analysis
queries.sql:
SELECT `Category`,
       ROUND(AVG(`Demand Forecast`), 2) AS avg_demand_forecast
FROM cleaned_inventory
GROUP BY `Category`
ORDER BY avg_demand_forecast DESC, `Category`;
